description: This file defines the IMembershipTable interface and related classes for managing cluster membership information within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership data, as well as classes representing membership entries and table versions.

classes.name: TableVersion
classes.description: Represents the version of the membership table, including a monotonically increasing version number and an ETag.

classes.name: MembershipTableData
classes.description: Encapsulates the data of the membership table, including a list of membership entries and the table version.

classes.name: MembershipEntry
classes.description: Represents a server node's membership information, including status, address, roles, and suspicion details.
